criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Layout, structural control and inpainting are documented; exact-product identity is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher samples only; no controlled AIVP output.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Detailed Python workflow, but separate base assets and substantial hardware are required.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Eight documented controls, explicit control scale and denser injection; repeatability unmeasured.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Guidance-distilled single forward pass per step documented; timing and failures unmeasured.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Weights are downloadable; compatible compute cost and cost per usable output are unknown.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Conditional commercial/output rights documented for Australia; territorial, attribution, disclosure and revenue-cap conditions apply.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Python integration exists; no hosted API or MCP route verified.

criteria.name: AU creator and SMB fit
criteria.notes: Australia is not excluded by licence, but hardware requirements are impractical for most SMBs.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Commercial use is conditional; no affiliate programme verified.
